checks.label: Assembly Code filled
checks.help: Every element needs its cost code so quantities can be priced.

checks.label: Fire rating on walls, doors and floors
checks.help: Walls, doors and floors must carry their fire rating so the other trades can coordinate with them.

checks.label: Mark on doors, windows, fixtures and equipment
checks.help: Each door, window and piece of equipment needs its own number so it can be found on site and at handover.

checks.label: Type Mark on doors and windows
checks.help: The type mark ties each door and window to its line in the schedule.

checks.label: Manufacturer on fixtures and equipment
checks.help: The owner needs to know who made each product to maintain or replace it.

checks.label: Element tied to a level
checks.help: An element that is not tied to a level cannot be counted by floor.
